references.title: Our History
observations: Riverside acquired an existing church building in April 2006.
The congregation identifies its current location as 1850 Woodland Avenue near Salisbury and Lindberg in West Lafayette.
references.geometry_use: Building identity and address corroboration only; no exterior dimensions, elevation, floor count, or roof description are provided.

references.title: Covenant Curch — West Lafayette, IN (2022)
observations: KJG describes a renovation of the church's sanctuary and entry spaces.
The project text mentions full-glass doors at an interior entry, a renovated lobby and lounge, and cantilevered entry canopies at childcare check-in.
references.geometry_use: Confirms a 2022 interior renovation scope. It does not identify the building's exterior roof shape, measured height, facade layout, or the location and dimensions of exterior doors and canopies.

references.source_date: 2016-09 (month inferred from page URL; exact photo date unavailable)
references.title: Covenant Church Entrance
observations: Broad, low roof eave above a long brick frontage.
Centered tall A-frame opening with a white perimeter and glazed panels, directly above a row of glazed entry doors.
Photo perspective and lack of known dimensions do not establish elevations or exact opening measurements.
references.geometry_use: Independent facade-composition reference for low roof, centered glazed A-frame, and multi-bay entry. Height, dimensions, roof pitch, and orientation relative to geographic north remain estimated.
references.provider: Church and States: Covenant Church, West Lafayette, Indiana (independent blog photograph)

modeling_limitations: Indiana Building Footprints feature 409445 (2016-2020 statewide layer; 2018 LiDAR vintage) independently overlaps the original OSM way 860918859 at 0.8867 IoU, but is not a legal survey and differs by about 12.7% in area.

The model follows the projected state GIS perimeter. Exact structural-wall boundary, north-facing entrance orientation, and surveyed position/dimensions are not established; the project conversion is approximate.
The 2016 exterior photo supports the low horizontal roof and centered glazed A-frame silhouette, but 4.5 m eaves, 5.7 m main ridge, 11.5 m glazed apex, roof pitch, and all heights are estimates.
The photo supports the broad brick frontage and multi-bay entrance composition. Side-window count/spacing, material colors, and exact opening dimensions remain schematic.
No measured exterior elevation or confirmed floor count was found.
